agentAttachmentLimitReached: You can attach up to 5 files

agentPromptDisabledTooltip: Configure a model before starting a chat.
agentLogEmpty: No actions have been applied yet. Ask the agent to refine the summary, quantify experience, or fill keyword gaps first.
agentLogInitialQuestion: Review this resume as a whole first.
agentDraftSynced: The preview is showing the highlighted draft
agentDraftErrorNoChange: Operation would not change the resume
agentDraftErrorConflict: Conflicts with the current resume edits
agentDraftApplyHint: The preview is showing an Agent draft you can apply or discard.
agentReplySummary: I would start by sharpening the summary so it states the role direction, stack, and your strongest differentiators immediately.
agentReplyBullets: The project and internship entries need stronger outcomes, scale, and impact signals, so I would quantify the most important bullets first.
agentReplyKeywords: I would compare the JD with your resume, then write the missing keywords back into the title, summary, and experience naturally.
agentReplyKnowledge: Based on the JD and the current resume, I put together a shortlist of knowledge areas and examples worth preparing in advance.
agentReplyContextApplied: I treated this message as the active job description. I will use it for edit suggestions, keyword coverage, and preparation guidance from here.
agentReplyGeneral: I have reviewed this resume and can help on three tracks at once: expression polish, direct resume edits, and preparation guidance.
agentSuggestionMissingSummary: The opening summary can state the role focus, stack, and your advantage more directly.
agentSuggestionQuantify: The key experiences still need numbers, scale, or outcome metrics.
agentSuggestionProof: Prepare one or two proof points such as project depth, architecture choices, or portfolio links.
agentKnowledgeGapHint: Prepare this as a three-part answer: definition, your project example, and likely follow-up questions.
agentKnowledgeStoryHint: Turn this experience into a full story: context, goal, trade-offs, and result.
agentKnowledgeProofHint: Bring one concrete proof point with metrics, architecture detail, or collaboration evidence.
agentNoJobBrief: No target JD is pasted yet. I can give general resume guidance first, and the advice will become much sharper after you add a JD.
agentRequestFailed: Agent request failed. Confirm the backend service is running and try again.
agentAppliedSummary: I have already refined the summary toward the current role.
agentAppliedBullet: I have already rewritten the key experience into a more quantified style.
agentAppliedKeywords: I have already written the role keywords back into the resume.
scoreSummaryGood: The structure is solid and the main role signals are already covered.
scoreSummaryWeak: Add missing keywords and quantify results across project and internship entries.
richTextHint: Supports bold, italic, underline, and plain-text paste.
